Hand-pinned like door_feed/section_feed: expect blocks were recorded ONCE via --record and reviewed line by line (record discipline); the Grundgesetz / disjunctive / grade / speed-floor laws that ARE ground truth are hand-pinned directly in SectionsSectionSpace.cs, never recorded. Sections here are named s-* on purpose: real GUIDs ride the shipped missions, the module only ever sees the feed strings.
